title: DeskAgent Memory Event
description: A memory event captured by DeskAgent. Four kinds: episodic (raw experiences), semantic (facts/preferences), procedural (how-to knowledge), working (active context). Local-first and user-owned per DEC-0009: stored locally, encrypted at rest, exportable, deletable.

content.description: The memory payload: raw transcript (episodic), a distilled fact (semantic), a how-to step (procedural), or an in-flight context note (working).

summary.description: Optional one-line summary used by the memory explorer.

source.description: Where the memory came from. extraction = capture pipeline distills raw episodes; reflection = consolidation/persona pass; synthesis = merged memories.

confidence.description: 0..1 certainty estimate; extraction and reflection passes may downgrade confidence.

episode_id.description: For derived memories, the source raw episode(s); comma-separated ids allowed.

type.description: companion = personal, spans all projects; project = scoped to one project (DEC-0009).

project_path.description: Optional filesystem path hint for the project scope.

approval.description: Every memory write routes through propose-to-remember approval (DEC-0009). pending until the user decides.
